extra_quotes: We run on the UPMEM DPU functional simulator (no physical PIM hardware) using the UPMEM SDK 2023.1.0 from the CMU-SAFARI mirror [ 13], driven by the stock dpu-upmem-dpurte-clang and llvm-objdump 12.0.0 .
Our results come from the UPMEM functional simulator rather than a physical DIMM.
Our scanner parses llvm-objdump text rather than decoding raw bytes, so a gadget the disassembler fails to render would be missed; this makes our counts a lower bound.
The functional simulator does not model cycle timing.

We report bounds rather than a cycle-accurate measurement because the UPMEM functional simulator exposes only committed-instruction counts [ 13], and a cycle-level DPU model is itself future work (Section IX).
